items.subject: Intra-block reduction primitive and synchronization
items.objective: Explore replacing reduce0's intra-block modulo/shared-memory reduction tree with a lower-synchronization block reduction, such as warp shuffles plus a small shared warp-partial exchange or an allowed CUB block primitive. To isolate this axis, retain the baseline's recursive global pass structure, 128-thread mapping, and one input element per lane; do not change the global tile geometry. Preserve correct synchronization and exact summation for every valid input, including safe handling of intermediate sums, and obey the scratch, stream, allocation, and bounds constraints. Validate all required inputs and compare repeated full-call measurements against the baseline; report failures and do not assume a local-kernel improvement guarantees a whole-call improvement.
